otp.subject: Your CB POS sign-in code: {otp}
otp.body:
Here's your code to sign in to ceybyte.com:

{otp}

It works for 10 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the code.

Ceylon Byte

site.offline: You’re offline. CB POS works offline — this website doesn’t.

footer.mission: Free point-of-sale software for Sri Lankan shops, made in Sri Lanka by Ceylon Byte.
footer.legalLine: CB POS comes as is, without a warranty. Its tax calculations aren’t certified by the IRD, and keeping backups of your data is up to you.
footer.copyright: © {year} Ceylon Byte. Made in Sri Lanka.

consent.body: This site uses PostHog to understand how people use CB POS. No personal details leave your browser.

errors.INVALID_PHONE: That doesn’t look like a Sri Lankan number. Try something like 77 123 4567.
errors.required: Please fill this in to continue.
errors.LOCATION_OUTSIDE_SRI_LANKA: That point is outside Sri Lanka. Drag the pin to where your shop is.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
errors.TURNSTILE_FAILED: The security check failed. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our end. Try again or contact support with request ID {requestId}.
